message: ぶぶづけ

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. I had no idea there were this many clubs.」
Piles of ledgers, receipts, and bankbooks stacked on the desk.

name: Misa
message: 「...What on earth does the 'Thick Roots Society' do?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「These are all the sorry remnants of cash. In other words, this is what you call 'the aftermath of warriors' dreams.'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, audit time, audit time!」

name: Synn
message: 「What are we supposed to do with these?」

name: Ria
message: 「We cross-check them against each club's activities to see if there are any inappropriate expenses.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Got it! Alright, let's do this. My hands are itching to start.」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai. What sort of expenses count as inappropriate?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How ignorant of you, Madam Vice President. Accounting is packed to the brim with the essence of a unique culture humanity has built up over thousands of years--things like double-entry books and slush-fund ledgers.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This one looks fine... Next is this one...」

name: Ria
message: 「This actually happened before, but the karate club once bought tons of movie DVDs and manga using club funds, claiming they were reference materials.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a tough call. Stuff like that might actually be a little useful as reference.」

name: Ria
message: 「But if we allowed that, then we'd have to approve every music-related movie for music clubs, and the same goes for sports clubs, as valid uses of club funds.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. You're a hundred years too early to be nitpicking what my dear sister says.」

name: Ria
message: 「Also, if there's any club that hasn't submitted its accounting records...」

name: Synn
message: 「If there is?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's a fundamental violation of the rules, so we'll immediately freeze their club funding without question and summon them right away to hear their explanation.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, no club has ever done that so far, so I don't think you need to worry too much about it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san. You seem awfully fired up, though wasn't yours the Sweets Appreciation Society? Don't tell me you forgot to submit your own group's accounts.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The Sweeets Appreciation Society! Not 'sweets'--'sweeets'!」

name: Misa
message: 「Does that tiny nuance really matter?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, we're not an official club, so we don't get a single cent. I'd take it if we could, though. Sweeets are expensive, you know...」

name: Misa
message: 「All you ever do is eat, so of course you don't get any」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There are clubs doing the exact same thing that still get club funding, so it's totally unfair!」

name: Ria
message: 「To start off, I think it's best if you get a general grasp of Student Council activities, so let's go through them together」

name: Ria
message: 「If you have any questions at all, just ask, okay?\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Oka~y\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, look. I think this is kinda fishy. Actually, scratch that, it's definitely fishy」

name: Ria
message: 「Let me see」

name: Synn
message: 「Manga Research Club... Artist's mannequin. Those dolls you can pose in all sorts of ways, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa. It's one of those naughty dolls that men use!」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte, be quiet for a second」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't it totally normal? Even for manga, you know... you still need to practice figure drawing」

name: Synn
message: 「Like what?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shoujo man--」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Never mind about that!\s09」

name: Ria
message: 「If it's an artist's mannequin, we approved one last year too, so I don't think there's any issue」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The issue is the store they bought it from. It says 'Ponpoko,' right? They don't carry any art supplies there, that's the thing」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. Even if they carry a little bit of everything, it's still a toy shop」

name: Lolotte
message: 「C-Could this be one of those adult toy shops famous for saying, 'No good boys and girls allowed. Wait until your Coming-of-Age Day'?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. They just stock whatever's trendy at the moment, right? And speaking of things around this price that they started stocking recently...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Wait a second. Is this that ridiculously expensive thing displayed in their front window?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The very one that made your jaw drop when you saw the price tag」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's what it was!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Going by the price, this isn't an artist's mannequin--what'd they call it, a figure? Looks like one of those cute girl dolls around thirty centimeters tall」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it definitely cost around that much」

name: Ria
message: 「If that's the case, this is an improper expense. I wonder if it was like this last year too... That's a bit of a shock」

name: Synn
message: 「They didn't sell stuff like that until last year, so I think it's fine」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's confiscate it, make them return the club funds, and demote them to a hobby group. And in exchange--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How exciting. This is somehow amazing. I sense the aura of justice. I'm going to uncover some fraud too!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's nothing amazing. You're just familiar with the shopping district, aren't you」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... That's what you'd call the howling of a sore loser」

name: Misa
message: 「Urgh. Even though you look so cute...」

name: Synn
message: 「Our job is to support everyone so they can enjoy their club activities, right? I don't think we need to be so authoritarian」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, let's have them pay back the embezzled club funds. Then we can evaluate their activities at the upcoming cultural festival and decide on their final punishment」

name: Ria
message: 「That sounds about right. They have a lot of members, so plenty of people would be in trouble if they lost their clubroom」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mgh... Well, if Senpai says so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「True, that clubroom would be way too big for us anyway...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No problem here... none here... ah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it an adult toy this time?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look at this. Right here under the Light Music Club's instrument expenses」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're quite ignorant, Treasurer. That's read as 'Yamaba Musical Instrument Store'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can read at least that much!」

name: Synn
message: 「Old Lady Yamanba's place, huh...」

name: Misa
message: 「I know this shop, though. 'Yamaba Musical Instrument Store' is a secondhand instrument shop, right? I don't think it's strange for them to sell instruments」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Our school's music-related clubs always rely on them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, look at this amount for the instrument they bought the day before yesterday」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa. F-Five hundred thou--?! Amazing, there's so many zeros?! With this much, I could live for ten, no, dozens of years...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... You won't survive if you're getting dizzy over this much」

name: Ria
message: 「Since this is so expensive, it's a 5% subsidy instead of a full reimbursement, huh」

name: Misa
message: 「Are musical instruments really this expensive? It certainly is strange」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. You're all so ignorant~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Humans are creatures who revere secondhand instruments used by rock stars and buy them at ridiculously high prices」

name: Misa
message: 「From your guidebook again...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For once, I think she's actually right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ms. Treasurer, you're casually quite rude, aren't you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whether a rock star actually used it or not, just being the same model they played makes it 'vintage' and shoots the price way up. You see them displayed behind the register all the time, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The souls of rock stars dwell within those instruments, causing them to play all on their own」

name: Ria
message: 「I-Is that so...」

name: Misa
message: 「There really is something skewed about her」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't be helped. She lived abroad for a long time, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「Is that really the issue?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Abroad, yes, abroad. Definitely not Heaven」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't think you need to go out of your way to say that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if it's only a 5% subsidy, I can't approve this. Confiscation. Club suspension. Demotion to a society」

name: Misa
message: 「What do we usually do in cases like this?」

name: Ria
message: 「Normally we'd confiscate it, but--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We really ought to shut down insolent clubs like this and redirect the funds to societies that are actually working hard」

name: Synn
message: 「That's pretty extreme. Sure, there was an issue with how they spent it, but I think that's way too harsh」

name: Synn
message: 「Out of 500,000 yen, they paid 475,000 out of their own pocket, so it was probably really tough for them to save up that money」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why do you assume they earned it themselves? It could be counterfeit bills, fake promissory notes, or counterfeit dollars, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Because even if you look at the Light Music Club's entire budget, they don't have anywhere near 470,000 yen」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah」

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「The president of the Light Music Club is actually in my class... Until recently, she was working a part-time job at a nearby convenience store. Could it be...」

name: Synn
message: 「She must have been working hard to save up money」

name: Ria
message: 「How has she been acting lately?」

name: Misa
message: 「She's been strangely giddy and restless, and it seems she heads straight to club activities as soon as classes end」

name: Synn
message: 「She must have been really happy about it. I bet she's playing it every day at club」

name: Misa
message: 「Now that you mention it... it looks like she switched her part-time shifts to the weekends」

name: Synn
message: 「Probably because she's going to club on weekdays... Even if we'd left her alone, I'm sure she would have paid back the 25,000 yen」

name: Ria
message: 「Why do you think she'd pay it back, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, she went out of her way to spend a huge sum of nearly 500,000 yen to buy it, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「If there were even a tiny bit of fraud mixed in, it'd be like a single little dark cloud in a clear blue sky--you wouldn't be able to enjoy it from the bottom of your heart, and that'd ruin it, wouldn't it? Though maybe that's naive of me」

name: Misa
message: 「Even so, embezzlement is embezzlement」

name: Synn
message: 「Since she submitted the financial report like this, I think she already expects us to find out about the discrepancy. So just being summoned by the Student Council will be enough for her to realize what it's about」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why... when we summon them, how about we give the Light Music Club a grace period of about a week?」

name: Ria
message: 「You intend to watch how she takes responsibility for the shortfall during that time, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. I believe she'll take responsibility by returning the missing amount, stepping down as club president, or something along those lines」

name: Synn
message: 「If she doesn't understand the gravity of what she's done and tries to play dumb, then confiscating it, suspending the club, or demoting them to a hobby society will be unavoidable」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. That sounds good」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Well, if Synn says so」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Impressive, Lord Synn. Showing off what a capable dictator you are, aren't ya?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I found one too! This is totally fraud!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's see」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Right here, right here! Even though they're the Track Club, they've been guzzling juice like crazy. And they have the nerve to pay for it out of club funds」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, that's not fraud」

name: Misa
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, pass the ones you're done checking over to me. Everyone else too」
Nanaka's amazing. She's still checking them even while talking.
Whoa. Her hands are flipping through the documents so fast!

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, yeah. Here you go. Still, what's going on here? Buying juice for the Track Club is bad, right? Even if it is an energy drink」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's got a name like juice and it's technically a liquid, yeah, but it's not juice. Apparently it's some kind of protein drink that promotes muscle growth」

name: Synn
message: 「Here, Nanaka. These are the ones I finished checking」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you know about that stuff, though?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eddie's in the Baseball Club, right? Well, he said they drink the exact same thing as the Track Club」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He said it's thick and sticky, leaves a nasty aftertaste that lingers forever, and makes your mouth feel all scratchy and gross」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. That would be what you call 'doping,' which always accompanies human sports」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And that's the last one. Check complete」

name: Misa
message: 「So fast!? Are you really done?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph. Don't underestimate the great Nanaka, who checks her shop's accounts every single day!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Making Nanaka-chan the treasurer really was the right call」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I wasn't the one who made her treasurer」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan became treasurer because you ran for Student Council president, right, Synn-kun?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's, um... you know! Just one of those inescapable bonds?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn's so unreliable you just can't leave him alone, right?\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, none of that matters anyway. Now, this is the last suspicious item」

name: Synn
message: 「The Gardening Club?」

name: Misa
message: 「I looked at that one, though... I don't think there was anything strange about it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looking at each expense individually, sure. There's nothing unrelated to gardening」

name: Ria
message: 「Then there shouldn't be any problem... Still, there must be a reason you're bringing this up, Nanaka-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes. When I total up the expenses on the receipts, it's higher than what's recorded in the ledger.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Time for secret ledgers and double-entry bookkeeping to take the stage!」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean they're embezzling... No, that's not it. How does the ledger look?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That part's fine. They're spending strictly within budget.」

name: Synn
message: 「So... when they got the receipts issued, they had them made out to the Gardening Club, meaning receipts they never billed to us got mixed in?」

name: Misa
message: 「...Still, if they're paying out of their own pockets, I don't see the problem.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Have any of you ever seen where the Gardening Club actually operates?」

name: Synn
message: 「All I really remember is a bunch of vinyl greenhouses lined up...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I did a three-day trial membership, and that place is amazing. The temperatures inside all ten greenhouses are completely automated by computers.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um, there's even a research lab you can't enter unless you sanitize your body, and I also got to eat grapes and peaches grown in the greenhouses. They were delicious.」

name: Misa
message: 「It sounds like you had quite a lot of fun... so why didn't you join?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because taking care of plants and stuff looked like too much work.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Amazing you ever felt like joining the Student Council, then.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm always raring to join anything that looks interesting. In other words, nothing ventured, no \{orphan|\s12\s12} gained.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ten greenhouses? I'm pretty sure there were only three last year... And there wasn't any research lab like that either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I knew it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Knew what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Vinyl greenhouses and a research lab you have to sterilize yourself to enter--I think that costs a ton of money. Way more than we could ever cover just working part-time jobs.」

name: Synn
message: 「So they're securing funds through some other means besides their club budget...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「More like, I think they're spending huge sums that don't even compare to the club budget.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because among all these receipts, there wasn't anything that looked related to vinyl greenhouses or a research lab.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though they were supposedly built this year, isn't it weird there's nothing here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like we're going to need to call them in.」

name: Misa
message: 「But I wonder if this actually counts as fraud? It's not like they're causing any harm to the academy. Nor are they overclaiming their club budget」

name: Synn
message: 「Club activities are part of academy life, after all. Even the club budgets come out of our tuition, so having large sums of unaccounted-for money moving around like this isn't good」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, if they can move that much money around so easily, there might not even be a need for the academy to give them a club budget at all. We could redirect that money to other clubs……」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no point getting ahead of ourselves. For now, we investigate where the money came from」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pretty sharp there, Soba. Guess swiping loose change from the soba shop register ain't just for show」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyone who spouts baseless nonsense like that gets this!」

name: Synn
message: 「You already did it before you even said that」

name: Misa
message: 「……It finished faster than expected」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though there was so much of it, it was over in the blink of an eye」

name: Misa
message: 「Unlike a certain someone, it seems the treasurer is actually competent」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President. I don't think there's any need to put yourself down like that」

name: Misa
message: 「I never said I was talking about myself!」

name: Ria
message: 「All that's left is to summon the clubs suspected of misconduct. At this rate, I can safely leave the accounting to you」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, though Synn-kun, I'm going to step out for a bit to look back through the Gardening Club's past accounts. Come to the next room if anything comes up」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes, understood」

name: Misa
message: 「I shall assist you as well♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank you. But sorry. If there was a mistake last year, the previous Student Council has to take responsibility for it」
Now that it's been entrusted to me, I have to stay sharp.

name: Synn
message: 「The ones with issues were the Manga Research Society, the Light Music Club, and the Gardening Club…… We're good with the plan we just discussed for the Light Music Club, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't really understand it all, but I think it's best if things can be settled amicably」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister agreed to it too, so there's no problem」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「……Seems fine to me?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're looking over the documents again…… Is something bothering you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, I don't think there's any problem with just calling in those three clubs...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, wait a second!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A classic reaction right as we're about to wrap up. So this is what they call a great detective」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't talk like Helena-san」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I knew it... I knew it... It's not here. Not here at all. Hehe」

name: Misa
message: 「Hehe?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did a club fail to submit their documents?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The 'Wagashi Club' is missing! Not here! Account books, receipts, bankbooks, none of it was submitted!」

name: Misa
message: 「Why do you look so happy about it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-An ally of justice naturally rejoices when they uncover corruption!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We need to summon them immediately for interrogation, torture, confession, trial, and punishment! Freeze their club funds, confiscate their clubroom, and demote them to a society!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, you really do look happy...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Even if it's just the tiny authority of a Student Council, power is a seductive demon. Madam Treasurer is drunk on the euphoria of wielding her authority」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Am not! It just proves what I've suspected all along」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They're always stuffing their faces with expensive wagashi, looking ridiculously well-off, and their president is a nasty piece of work who acts all high and mighty」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Meanwhile, we're over here scraping by on our measly pocket money doing the same sweets-related activities, so I've been wondering for ages why things are so unfair, and now」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To think they were cooking the books so badly they couldn't even submit them to the Student Council--I bet they were embezzling club funds for those sweets all along. I've finally caught them red-handed!」

name: Misa
message: 「...That's a personal grudge」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Definitely a personal grudge」

name: Synn
message: 「That sounds like nothing but a personal grudge, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-My heart is simply burning with justice! We ought to demote those guys to a society and promote a hardworking sweets-related society to full club status in their place」

name: Synn
message: 「Like the Sweets Society, for example?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Exactly」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I mean, it's just that there aren't any other sweets-related societies, okay? There's no ulterior motive here, none at all」

name: Misa
message: 「'A heart of justice,' huh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It sounds like nothing more than personal greed to me」

name: Paqy
message: 「Buy your own damn sweets with your own money, soba」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-They definitely haven't submitted their financial report, so it's obvious they're committing fraud!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To begin with, I always thought it was weird they got full club status without even having a clubroom, and the way they're always showing off by stuffing their faces with expensive-looking wagashi at Prier is so obnoxious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And all that 'yer welcome' and 'is that so'--sure, it might've been the capital in the old days, but I couldn't stand that attitude of talking deliberately slow to look down on people either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, she's already retired and probably isn't the president anymore, so it's a tiny bit disappointing I can't string her up for it, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's the big deal about wagashi anyway? Sure, some of them are good, they are, okay, but Western sweets are delicious too!」

name: Misa
message: 「...It really is just a personal grudge」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It really is just a personal grudge, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「It really does sound like nothing but a personal grudge, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up! I might not entirely refuse to admit there's a tiny bit of a personal grudge mixed in, maybe, but fraud is fraud, and justice is justice!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And that does it for the paperwork to freeze the Wagashi Club's funding」

name: Synn
message: 「That was fast!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, I'm going to summon them!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka!」

name: Synn
message: 「And she's already gone...」

name: Misa
message: 「What are we supposed to do now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, fraud is fraud, and justice is justice. Render unto Kasael the things that are Kasael's」

name: Misa
message: 「You mean \{frog|\s12\s12}」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Regardless of the circumstances, it's a fact that they haven't submitted it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Will the representative of the Wagashi Club, or their proxy, please report to the Student Council room immediately」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I repeat. Will the representative of the Wagashi Club, or their proxy, please report to the Student Council room immediately」

name: Synn
message: 「That was fast」

name: Misa
message: 「So she's competent when personal grudges are involved……」

name: Synn
message: 「I think she's competent as treasurer even when personal grudges aren't involved, though」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Summoning someone! It's kinda like the KGB, so cool!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't lump her in with the secret police. I do think she's competent, but personal grudges are definitely involved in this case. Without a doubt」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I don't think there's any problem with calling them in. We have to hear what the situation is, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「What do you mean you summoned the Wagashi Club's representative!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heh heh heh. I went right ahead and called them over!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai. The Wagashi Club is……」

name: Female Student
message: 「Wagashi Club, at your service」

name: Synn
message: 「That was fast…… It's open, so come on in」

name: Female Student
message: 「Excuse me for intruding」
The person who appeared was an upperclassman one year above us whom I had seen a few times before.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why is Bubuzuke here!」

name: Female Student
message: 「Well, well, if it isn't the president of the Sweets Society. It's been quite a while」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not that I wanted to see you, though」

name: Female Student
message: 「Oh, what a cold person you are」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Too bad. Weren't you supposed to have retired?」

name: Female Student
message: 「My post-graduation path is already decided, you see, so I haven't retired just yet」

name: Nanaka
message: 「……Well, whatever. You're actually more convenient for me」

name: Female Student
message: 「Now, now, there's no need to welcome me so warmly」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not welcoming you」

name: Female Student
message: 「Well, isn't that just fine in its own way?」

name: Synn
message: 「You two know each other?」

name: Female Student
message: 「We are acquaintances who know each other terribly, deeply well, right down to our very cores.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't say gross things! You and I are enemies, enemies!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's just Japanese sweets versus Western sweets anyway, isn't it?」

name: Female Student
message: 「My, you're quite the troublesome person too, aren't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Troublesome?」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, let's see. If I remember right, it means a complicated or difficult person, I think?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See what I mean? I hate how she uses this roundabout way of talking to secretly talk behind your back even when she's standing right in front of you.」

name: Female Student
message: 「I'm an honest person, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In what world!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um. Thank you for going out of your way to come here. For now, please have a seat right there.」

name: Female Student
message: 「How very polite of you, thank you kindly. I was starting to think we'd be carrying on this whole conversation standing up. Well then, I won't hold back and will gladly take a seat.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the president of the 'Wagashi Club'」
The woman in front of us brushed back her long hair before answering.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ayane Misasagi is me. I heard you had some business with the 'Wagashi Club', though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi, as in...」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, that Misasagi.」
If she's a Misasagi, does that mean she lives in that massive mansion!
When that mansion was built about three years ago, my milk delivery route had to take a big detour, and it was tough getting used to it...
Paying no mind to us being surprised and lost in our own thoughts, Nanaka――

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your club is doing fraudulent accounting, isn't it!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now let's see... whatever could you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've thought it was weird for a while now. Stuffing your faces with expensive Japanese sweets day after day after day--I wondered where on earth all that money was coming from, and now I get it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Couldn't she just be getting a huge allowance...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The mystery is completely solved! If you're embezzling club funds, then there's nothing strange about it at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, hey, Nanaka-chan\s01」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You're free to jump to all sorts of complicated misunderstandings all by yourself, dear, however...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Having baseless rumors spread around in public is a nuisance to all our club members, so you won't mind if I set the record straight, will you」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Those expenses all came straight out of our own pockets」

name: Synn
message: 「I see~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't lie at this late stage, quit lying--even I know how expensive wagashi are」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They're so tiny, yet you can buy several sweets for the price. There's no way that's just pocket money」

name: Ria
message: 「Nana--」
Misasagi-senpai hid her mouth behind her folding fan and let out a soft chuckle.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, we would never do anything so underhanded」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Besides, to truly savor sweets from the bottom of your heart, it has to hurt your own wallet a little」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Precisely because it hurts your wallet, you can savor the sweets from the bottom of your heart」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Free or paid, the taste is the same! Or rather, I'd much prefer something easy on my wallet!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Saying you can't properly critique the taste without paying for it disqualifies you as president of a sweets-related club」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Isn't that perfectly fine in its own way? We are us, and others are others, after all」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Though I did hear that when you eat sweets, you also make it a principle to hurt your own wallet」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, yeah, that's true, but」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Then, since we've reached a nice punchline, shall we call it a day?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Hey, you. You haven't answered properly at all」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... You're only noticing now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Weren't you noticing and just enjoying the show?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Indeed. Perhaps you're right. Even so, when someone says something so absurdly careless to me, I haven't the faintest idea how I ought to respond」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then brace yourself, 'cause I'm gonna lay it out so flat you won't have a single word to say back! Neither the account books, the bankbook, nor the receipts have been submitted from the 'Wagashi Club'!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, of course. Naturally. Since we haven't submitted them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you don't submit them, there's immediate suspension of club funds...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know full well there are penalties like demotion from a full club to a society, yet you still don't submit them--that means you've got something shady you can't possibly hide!」
Misasagi-senpai held her opened folding fan to her mouth and pondered for a moment, before.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wonder what sort of undeniably shady things you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Obviously, taking advantage of your club budget to stuff your faces with Japanese sweets! Come on, spill it!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, scary. We aren't doing anything of the sort, though--is that what you're planning to do once your Sweets Society gets promoted to a full club?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, we're us and others are others, so I suppose that's fine in its own way.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-wh-wh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if I'd ever think of doing something like that!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You might not know this, but the Student Council has a super important position called Treasurer, and apparently they make sure nobody can pull off such \{greedy|あこぎ} stunts.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's a waste of time even thinking about it, so give it up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I AM the Treasurer!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Really!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Haaah. Well, well... is that so? Do your very best, then.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr!」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan. Listen, um...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Besides, I'm terribly sorry to say, since we don't receive any club budget, we don't even have any account books, receipts, or bankbooks to submit in the first place.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... No way. I mean, you guys are an official club, aren't you!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We're a society.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai. Is that true?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. It's been like that for ages, I think...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「From what I hear, way back when, we had an exchange with another academy's Tea Ceremony Club.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The board chairman at the time thought it wouldn't look good if the two sides weren't on equal footing, so they granted us official club status in name only.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ever since then, we've been treated as an official club.」

name: Ria
message: 「I tried to tell her so many times... and you kept cutting me off every single time. That's so mean, Ayanishiki-chan\s06」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Forgive me, Ria. It's just so fun teasing this one, I couldn't help myself. I really do run my mouth too much.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That concludes our business, yes... Now then, might I take my leave?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. I understand completely. Sorry for calling you out all this way.」
Senpai Misasagi snapped her folding fan shut with a crisp sound--

name: Misasagi
message: 「Think nothing of it, as that is your duty, after all. My apologies to you as well, Miss Treasurer. Pardon the intrusion.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's why I can't stand that woman. She's seriously nasty.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's because you don't listen to what people are saying.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, she was subtly cutting her off, so it couldn't be helped.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I feel like I lost...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being Japanese sweets versus Western sweets, they naturally don't get along. Is this what they call 'getting along like fish and water'?」

name: Ria
message: 「No... If anything, wouldn't it be 'a clash between a dragon and a tiger'?」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't know, so it couldn't be helped. Besides, I think you did a splendid job as treasurer.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You think so? Ehehe」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Impressive as always, Lord Synn. Following up to lock down even a girl you've already bagged--you've got her wrapped right around your finger.」

name: Ria
message: 「It was my fault too for not mentioning there were exceptions for club activities.」

name: Synn
message: 「We still have to call in the other clubs. I'm counting on you, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you sure? Counting on me, I mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I am.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, leave the accounting to me!」
Yeah. Nanaka really is best when she's full of energy.
